name: submit_application
description: Public entry point for candidate-initiated applications. Takes a name, email, optional LinkedIn URL, and a short 'why' paragraph; runs the same parse_intake-style normalisation as our Telegram/manual paths but tags the source as 'site' so the operator knows where it came from. Returns the new candidate id so the apply page can show a confirmation. Idempotent on (email, role_slug) within 5 minutes to swallow accidental double-submits from twitchy 'Submit' buttons.
